notes: Original observed posterior = raw clean - shrinkage + filtered realized noise. True variance stays fixed in the gain.
Noise removed substitutes noiseless received IQ without lowering regularization. Shrinkage removed uses true clean + original filtered noise.
Both need exact clean and simulator factors and are source-only counterfactuals. No new deployment candidate, no effect on Main scheduling.
